experts.name: Gary Magnone
experts.title: Fractional Operations Leader, Highrise
experts.headline: I help agency leadership teams align on growth priorities and build the execution capacity to make them move.
experts.bio: Gary Magnone has spent 15+ years on the agency side across strategy, delivery, accounts, operations and growth, and now works as a fractional operator embedded with agency leadership teams. His skills encode how he runs the conversations that turn a vague "delivery is painful" into one quantified problem, a price the owner has already justified, and a booked next step.

skills.title: Delivery audit discovery call
skills.description: Use this skill when you have 30 minutes with the owner of a professional service firm or agency (an existing customer, a closed-lost contact, or a net new prospect) to find the one client-delivery problem worth building a custom solution or pilot for. Produces a quantified pain (annual dollar figure plus opportunity cost in the owner's own words), a price framing delivered on the call, and a booked next step. Also use for "delivery audit", "AI audit call", "discovery call for a custom build", "scope a pilot", "find the gnarliest workflow", "price on the call".
